name.en: Bubur ayam

en: 50 g rice
70 g shredded chicken breast
4 cups chicken stock
Lime leaf, ginger, turmeric
Fried shallots, spring onion, soy sauce
Cook the rice in the stock with ginger and turmeric 45 minutes
Stir often until it turns creamy
Add the shredded chicken and warm 5 minutes
Serve topped with fried shallots, spring onion and soy sauce

name.en: Tempeh and egg scramble

en: 100 g tempeh, crumbled
1 egg
1 garlic clove, 1 small onion
Red chilli, celery leaf
1 tsp oil, sweet soy sauce
Sauté the garlic, onion and chilli in the oil
Add the crumbled tempeh and stir 4 minutes
Crack in the egg and scramble it through the mixture
Finish with the sweet soy sauce and celery leaf

name.en: Lontong Sayur (Rice Cake in Vegetable Coconut Curry)

en: Pressed cooked rice cake (lontong) or plain rice 150 g
Long beans and carrot, chopped, 150 g total
Light coconut milk 100 ml
1 small onion, 1 crushed garlic clove and turmeric half a tsp
1 tsp oil and salt
Crispy fried shallots for garnish (optional)
Brown the onion and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes, add the turmeric and stir for a minute.
Add the long beans and carrot and stir for two minutes.
Add the coconut milk and a little water, cover and simmer 10-12 minutes until the vegetables are cooked and the texture thickens.
Slice the lontong or place the rice in a serving bowl, pour the curry over it, garnish with fried shallots if desired, and serve warm.

name.en: Nasi Uduk with Egg and Tempeh (Coconut Rice)

en: White rice cooked with light coconut milk 150 g
1 boiled egg, halved
Tempeh, sliced, 50 g
Sliced cucumber to serve
Crispy fried shallots and a little salt for garnish
1 tsp oil for browning the tempeh
Boil the rice with the light coconut milk and salt until cooked and fragrant.
Heat the oil and fry the tempeh slices two minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Place the rice on a serving plate.
Arrange the boiled egg, tempeh and cucumber around it, garnish with fried shallots, and serve warm.

name.en: Mini Nasi Kuning (Indonesian Turmeric Rice with Egg)

en: Cooked white rice 150 g
Turmeric half a tsp and light coconut milk 50 ml
1 small crushed garlic clove and a kaffir lime leaf (optional)
1 boiled egg, halved
Sliced cucumber to serve
Crispy fried shallots and salt for garnish
Mix the cooked rice with the turmeric, crushed garlic, coconut milk and kaffir lime leaf in a small pan over low heat 5-7 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice turns yellow and fragrant.
Add a little salt and adjust the flavour.
Place it on a serving plate shaped into a small dome.
Arrange the boiled egg and cucumber around it, garnish with fried shallots, and serve warm.

name.en: Bubur Kacang Hijau (Sweet Mung Bean Porridge with Coconut Milk)

en: Split mung beans 50 g
Water 300 ml
Brown sugar 25 g
Light coconut milk 60 ml
1 thin slice of ginger and a pinch of salt
A kaffir lime leaf (optional)
Wash the mung beans thoroughly and place them with the water in a pot.
Cook over medium heat 20-25 minutes until fully cooked and starting to break down.
Add the brown sugar, ginger, salt and kaffir lime leaf, cook 5 more minutes.
Pour into a serving bowl and drizzle the coconut milk over it, and serve warm.

name.en: Roti Bakar with Banana and Peanut (Indonesian Toast)

en: Whole-wheat bread, 2 slices (60 g)
1 small ripe banana, sliced
Coarsely ground peanuts 1 tbsp
Honey 1 tsp
A thin layer of low-fat butter
A pinch of ground cinnamon (optional)
Toast the bread slices in a toaster or dry pan until lightly golden.
Butter one slice.
Arrange the banana slices over it, sprinkle with the ground peanuts and honey.
Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired, cover with the other slice, cut in half and serve immediately.

name.en: Telur Dadar Sayur (Indonesian Vegetable Omelette)

en: 2 eggs
Grated cabbage, grated carrot and spring onion, 80 g total
1 crushed garlic clove, salt and black pepper
1 tsp oil
A little low-sodium sweet soy sauce to serve (optional)
Beat the eggs with salt and black pepper.
Add the cabbage, carrot, spring onion and garlic and mix well.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, pour in the mixture and spread it evenly.
Cook 3-4 minutes on the first side until set, flip and cook 2-3 more minutes until fully cooked, and serve with the sweet soy sauce if desired.

name.en: Bihun Goreng (Fried Rice Vermicelli)

en: Cooked rice vermicelli 100 g
Chicken breast, small pieces, or shrimp, 80 g
Shredded cabbage, grated carrot and spring onion, 100 g total
2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tsp oil
Low-sodium sweet soy sauce 2 tbsp
1 egg and crispy fried shallots for garnish
Heat the oil and brown the garlic for a minute.
Add the chicken or shrimp and stir until fully cooked.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir for two minutes until slightly softened.

Add the vermicelli and sweet soy sauce and mix well, push it aside and crack the egg in, stirring until cooked, then mix it in with everything, garnish with spring onion and fried shallots and serve hot.

name.en: Baked Martabak Telur (Savory Egg-Stuffed Pancake)

en: 1 sheet thin whole-wheat pastry (50 g)
2 eggs
Lean minced chicken 50 g
Chopped spring onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
A pinch of turmeric, salt and black pepper
1 tsp oil for brushing
Brown the minced chicken in a dry pan for 4-5 minutes until fully cooked.
Beat the eggs with the spring onion, garlic, turmeric, salt and black pepper, add the cooked chicken and mix.
Lay the pastry sheet on a lined tray, pour the egg mixture in the centre and fold the four edges inward to form a sealed square.
Brush with oil and bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until the egg is fully cooked and the pastry surface is golden, cut into squares and serve hot.

name.en: Nasi goreng

en: 150 g cold cooked rice
100 g chicken breast, cubed
1 egg
2 garlic cloves, 1 shallot, chilli
1 tsp oil, sweet soy sauce, vegetables
Pound the garlic, shallot and chilli into a paste
Heat the oil, fry the paste, then add the chicken
Add the egg and scramble it, then the rice and vegetables
Add the sweet soy sauce and toss on high heat 3 minutes

name.en: Soto ayam

en: 120 g chicken breast
3 cups water
Turmeric, ginger, garlic, lemongrass
50 g cooked rice vermicelli
Bean sprouts, 1 boiled egg, celery
Pound the turmeric, ginger and garlic and fry briefly
Add the water, lemongrass and chicken, simmer 20 minutes
Take out the chicken, shred it and return it to the broth
Put the vermicelli and sprouts in a bowl and ladle the broth over

name.en: Mie Goreng (Indonesian Fried Noodles)

en: Cooked whole-wheat noodles 100 g
Chicken breast or shrimp, small pieces, 100 g
Shredded cabbage, grated carrot and spring onion, 100 g total
Low-sodium sweet soy sauce (kecap manis) 2 tbsp
2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tsp oil
1 egg and crispy fried shallots for garnish
Heat the oil and brown the garlic for a minute.
Add the chicken or shrimp and stir until fully cooked.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir for two minutes until slightly softened.

Add the noodles and sweet soy sauce and mix well until combined, push the mixture aside and crack the egg into the pan, stirring until cooked, then mix it in with everything, garnish with spring onion and fried shallots and serve hot.

name.en: Sayur Asem (Sour Vegetable Soup)

en: Raw shelled peanuts 30 g
Squash, corn and long beans, chopped, 200 g total
Tamarind (dissolved in warm water) 2 tbsp, or lemon juice as an alternative
1 small onion, 1 crushed garlic clove and brown sugar half a tsp
Light vegetable stock 400 ml
Salt and a little chili (optional)
Boil the raw peanuts in water for 15 minutes until slightly softened.
Brown the onion and garlic in a dry pot for two minutes.
Add the stock, tamarind water, brown sugar and peanuts, cook over medium heat 10 minutes.
Add the squash, corn and beans, cook 10-12 more minutes until the vegetables are cooked, adjust the salt and chili, and serve hot.

name.en: Nasi Campur (Mixed Rice Platter)

en: Cooked white rice 150 g
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 80 g
Tempeh, sliced, 40 g
Boiled green beans and grated carrot, 100 g total
1 boiled egg, halved
Low-sodium sweet soy sauce 1 tsp and crispy fried shallots for garnish
Place the rice in the centre of a serving plate.
Arrange the chicken, tempeh, green beans and carrot around the rice in an attractive arrangement.
Place the egg halves on top of the platter.
Drizzle a light amount of sweet soy sauce over the components, garnish with fried shallots, and serve immediately.

name.en: Bakso (Indonesian Meatball Soup)

en: Lean minced beef 100 g
1 crushed garlic clove and cornflour 1 tsp for the meatballs
1 egg for the meatballs, salt and black pepper
Thin cooked noodles 50 g
Light vegetable stock 500 ml
Chopped spring onion and celery, and crispy fried shallots for garnish
Knead the minced beef with the garlic, cornflour, egg, salt and black pepper thoroughly until it binds together.
Shape into small, equally sized balls.
Bring the stock to a boil in a wide pot, add the meatballs and simmer 12-15 minutes until they float and are fully cooked.
Add the cooked noodles, adjust the salt, garnish with spring onion, celery and fried shallots, and serve hot.

name.en: Soto Betawi (Jakarta Beef Soup with Coconut Milk)

en: Lean beef, small cubes, 100 g
Light coconut milk 150 ml
1 small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and turmeric half a tsp
Grated ginger and a pinch of ground coriander
Light vegetable stock 250 ml and salt
Chopped tomato and spring onion for garnish
Brown the onion, garlic and ginger in a dry pot for 3 minutes.
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour.
Add the turmeric and coriander and stir for a minute, then add the stock.
Cover and simmer 40-45 minutes until the beef is tender, add the coconut milk and cook 5 more minutes, adjust the salt, garnish with tomato and spring onion and serve hot.

name.en: Ketoprak (Rice Cake, Tofu and Bean Sprouts with Peanut Sauce)

en: Cooked rice cake (lontong) or cooked rice 150 g
Firm tofu, cubed and lightly fried, 80 g
Bean sprouts, boiled, 80 g
Coarsely ground peanuts 40 g for the sauce
Warm water 60 ml and low-sodium sweet soy sauce 1 tsp for the sauce
Crispy fried shallots and a little lemon juice for garnish
Slice the rice cake or place the rice on a serving plate.
Arrange the fried tofu and bean sprouts over it.
For the sauce, mix the ground peanuts with the warm water and sweet soy sauce until combined.
Pour the sauce over the components, sprinkle with lemon juice and garnish with fried shallots, and serve immediately.

name.en: Nasi Pecel (Rice with Steamed Vegetables and Peanut Sauce)

en: Cooked white rice 150 g
Long beans, cabbage and bean sprouts, boiled, 150 g total
Boiled spinach 50 g
Coarsely ground peanuts 40 g for the sauce
Warm water 60 ml and low-sodium sweet soy sauce 1 tsp for the sauce
Crispy fried shallots and a little lemon juice for garnish
Place the rice on a serving plate.
Arrange the long beans, cabbage, bean sprouts and spinach around it.
For the sauce, mix the ground peanuts with the warm water and sweet soy sauce until combined.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables, sprinkle with lemon juice and garnish with fried shallots, and serve immediately.

name.en: Nasi Liwet (Javanese Aromatic Coconut Rice with Chicken)

en: White rice 150 g
Light coconut milk 100 ml and water 100 ml
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 80 g
2 crushed garlic cloves and a kaffir lime leaf or bay leaf
Chopped spring onion and salt
Crispy fried shallots for garnish
Wash the rice and place it in a pot with the coconut milk, water, garlic, kaffir lime leaf and salt.
Cook over medium heat until the water starts to dry up, then reduce the heat to minimum and cover the pot.
Cook 15-18 more minutes without lifting the lid until the rice is fully cooked and fragrant.
Add the shredded chicken and stir gently, garnish with spring onion and fried shallots, and serve hot.

name.en: Ikan bakar grilled fish

en: 170 g whole fish or fillet
2 garlic cloves, 1 shallot
Turmeric, ginger, red chilli
1 tbsp oil, sweet soy sauce
Juice of 1 lime, salt
Pound the garlic, shallot and spices with the oil
Rub the fish with the paste and lime, rest 20 minutes
Grill 7 minutes per side on a hot grill
Brush with sweet soy sauce in the last 2 minutes

name.en: Gado-gado

en: 1 boiled egg and 70 g tofu
Blanched green beans, cabbage, bean sprouts
Cucumber and boiled potato
2 tbsp peanut butter
Garlic, lime, sweet soy sauce, water
Mix the peanut butter with garlic, lime and sweet soy sauce
Add warm water gradually until it becomes a pourable sauce
Pan-fry the tofu lightly until golden
Arrange vegetables, egg and tofu, pour the sauce over

name.en: Light Rendang (Slow-Cooked Spiced Beef) with Rice

en: Lean beef, small cubes, 120 g
Light coconut milk 150 ml
1 medium onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and grated ginger
Turmeric, ground coriander and cumin, half a tsp each
Curry leaves or a bay leaf (optional) and salt
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Brown the onion, garlic and ginger in a dry pot for 3 minutes.
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour.
Add the turmeric, coriander and cumin and stir for a minute, then add the coconut milk and curry leaves.
Cover and simmer on very low heat 50-60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender and the texture thickens richly, adjust the salt, and serve with the rice.

name.en: Ayam Bakar (Grilled Spiced Chicken) with Rice

en: Skinless chicken breast or thighs 140 g
1 small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and turmeric half a tsp
Ground coriander and a pinch of cumin each
Brown sugar half a tsp and lemon juice 1 tsp
Salt and 1 tsp oil
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Mix the onion, garlic, turmeric, coriander, cumin, brown sugar, lemon juice and salt to make the marinade.
Rub the chicken thoroughly with the marinade and let it sit at least 30 minutes or overnight in the fridge.
Arrange on a lined tray and brush with oil.
Bake at 220°C for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway, until fully cooked and toasted on the outside, then grill under the broiler for a final 2-3 minutes for light char marks, and serve with the rice.

name.en: Sate Ayam (Grilled Chicken Skewers with Peanut Sauce)

en: Chicken breast, cubed, 140 g
Low-sodium sweet soy sauce 1 tbsp and 1 crushed garlic clove for the marinade
Coarsely ground peanuts 30 g for the sauce
Warm water 50 ml and a little sweet soy sauce for the sauce
A little lemon juice and mild chili (optional)
Wooden skewers soaked in water
Mix the sweet soy sauce and crushed garlic, marinate the chicken in it for at least 20 minutes.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the skewers.
Grill under the broiler or in a 220°C oven for 15-18 minutes, turning, until fully cooked and golden.
For the sauce, mix the ground peanuts with the warm water, a little sweet soy sauce and lemon juice until combined, serve it with the chicken skewers.

name.en: Baked Pepes Ikan (Spiced Fish in Banana Leaf) with Rice

en: White fish fillet 140 g
1 small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and turmeric half a tsp
Grated ginger and chopped fresh coriander
Lemon juice 1 tsp and salt
Banana leaf for wrapping (or foil as a substitute)
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Mix the onion, garlic, turmeric, ginger, coriander, lemon juice and salt to make the marinade paste.
Rub the fish thoroughly with the paste and let it sit 15 minutes.
Wrap the fish tightly in the banana leaf or foil.
Bake at 200°C for 20-25 minutes until fully cooked, and serve with the rice.

name.en: Baked Ayam Goreng Bumbu (Indonesian Spiced Fried Chicken) with Rice

en: Skinless chicken thighs 140 g
1 small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and turmeric half a tsp
Ground coriander and a pinch of cumin each
Grated ginger and salt
Lemon juice 1 tsp and 1 tsp oil
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Mix the onion, garlic, turmeric, coriander, cumin, ginger, lemon juice and salt to make the marinade paste.
Rub the chicken thoroughly with the paste and let it sit at least 30 minutes or overnight in the fridge.
Arrange on a lined tray and brush with oil.
Bake at 220°C for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway, until fully cooked and golden on the outside, and serve with the rice.

name.en: Opor Ayam (Chicken in Mild Coconut Curry) with Rice

en: Skinless chicken breast or thighs, chopped, 140 g
Light coconut milk 150 ml
1 small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and ground coriander half a tsp
Cumin and turmeric a pinch each, and grated ginger
A kaffir lime leaf or bay leaf (optional) and salt
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Brown the onion, garlic and ginger in a dry pot for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and stir until it changes colour.
Add the coriander, cumin and turmeric and stir for a minute, then add the coconut milk and kaffir lime leaf.
Cover and simmer 20-25 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and the texture thickens, adjust the salt, and serve with the rice.

name.en: Baked Ikan Bumbu Kuning (Fish in Yellow Spice Sauce) with Rice

en: White fish fillet 140 g
1 small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and turmeric 1 tsp
A pinch of ground coriander and grated ginger
Lemon juice 1 tsp and salt
1 tsp oil for brushing
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Mix the onion, garlic, turmeric, coriander, ginger, lemon juice and salt to make the marinade paste.
Rub the fish thoroughly with the paste and let it sit 15 minutes.
Arrange on a lined tray and brush with oil.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until fully cooked and it flakes easily, and serve with the rice.

name.en: Semur Daging (Sweet Soy Braised Beef) with Rice

en: Lean beef, small cubes, 120 g
1 medium onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and a pinch of nutmeg
Low-sodium sweet soy sauce 2 tbsp
Light vegetable stock 250 ml and a bay leaf
1 medium tomato, chopped, and salt
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Brown the onion and garlic in a dry pot for 3 minutes.
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour.
Add the sweet soy sauce, nutmeg, stock, bay leaf and tomato.
Cover and simmer 45-50 minutes until the beef is tender and the texture thickens, adjust the salt, and serve with the rice.

name.en: Baked spiced tempeh bites

en: 80 g tempeh, thinly sliced
1 tsp oil
1 garlic clove, crushed
Ground coriander, turmeric
Salt, lime juice
Mix the oil, garlic, spices and salt
Coat the tempeh slices in the mixture
Bake 20 minutes at 200°C, turning halfway
Squeeze the lime juice over before serving

name.en: Rujak spicy fruit salad

en: Green mango, pineapple, cucumber
Guava or green apple
1 tsp tamarind paste
1 tsp coconut sugar
A pinch of chilli, salt
Cut the fruit and cucumber into medium chunks
Mix the tamarind, sugar, chilli and salt
Add a spoon of warm water to loosen the dressing
Pour over the fruit and toss just before serving

name.en: Baked Pisang Goreng (Banana Fritters)

en: 2 medium ripe bananas (200 g)
Whole-wheat flour 40 g
Brown sugar 1 tsp and a pinch of salt
About 30 ml water
A pinch of ground cinnamon (optional)
1 tsp oil for brushing
Mash half the banana with a fork, and cut the other half into lengthwise slices.
Mix the mashed banana with the flour, brown sugar, salt and water gradually until a thick, soft dough-like batter forms.
Dip the banana slices in the batter to fully coat them.
Arrange on a lined tray, brush with oil, sprinkle with cinnamon if desired, and bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

name.en: Baked Perkedel (Indonesian Potato Patties)

en: Boiled, mashed potato 200 g
Chopped spring onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
1 egg
A pinch of ground coriander, salt and black pepper
1 tbsp whole-wheat flour
1 tsp oil for brushing
Mix the mashed potato with the spring onion, garlic, egg, coriander, salt, black pepper and flour until well combined.
Shape the mixture into small flat patties with your hands.
Arrange on a lined tray and brush both sides with oil.
Bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

name.en: Baked Bakwan Sayur (Indonesian Vegetable Fritters)

en: Grated cabbage, grated carrot and long beans, chopped, 200 g total
Chopped spring onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Whole-wheat flour 50 g and 1 egg
A pinch of ground coriander, salt and black pepper
About 30 ml water
1 tsp oil for brushing
Mix the cabbage, carrot and beans with the spring onion and garlic in a large bowl.
Add the flour, egg, coriander, salt, black pepper and water gradually until a thick, cohesive batter forms.
Spoon the mixture into small flat mounds on a lined tray.
Brush the tops with oil and bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

name.en: Baked Tahu Isi (Indonesian Stuffed Tofu)

en: Firm tofu, 3 medium pieces (150 g)
Grated carrot, shredded cabbage and spring onion, 80 g total
1 crushed garlic clove, salt and black pepper
1 egg for coating
Fine breadcrumbs 30 g
1 tsp oil for brushing
Cut each piece of tofu in the middle to form a pocket without cutting all the way through.
Mix the carrot, cabbage and spring onion with the garlic, salt and black pepper.
Carefully stuff each tofu piece with the mixture.
Coat in the beaten egg, then the breadcrumbs, arrange on a lined tray and brush with oil, and bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

name.en: Baked Risoles (Indonesian Stuffed Pastry Rolls)

en: Cooked, shredded chicken breast 60 g
Grated carrot and potato, small cubes, 80 g total
Chopped spring onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Whole-wheat flour 50 g, 1 egg and low-fat milk 100 ml for the crepe batter
Fine breadcrumbs 30 g and another egg for coating
Salt, black pepper and 1 tsp oil for brushing
Mix the flour with the egg and milk until a smooth, liquid batter forms for the crepe wrappers.
Heat a non-stick pan and pour a thin layer of the batter, cook 1 minute without flipping until set, repeat to get 4-5 wrappers.
Mix the shredded chicken with the carrot, potato, spring onion, garlic, salt and black pepper for the filling.

Place a spoonful of filling on each wrapper, roll tightly, coat in the beaten egg then the breadcrumbs, arrange on a lined tray and brush with oil, and bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

name.en: Baked Otak-Otak (Indonesian Spiced Fish Cake)

en: Chopped white fish fillet 150 g
Light coconut milk 30 ml
Chopped spring onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
A pinch of turmeric and a pinch of ground coriander
1 egg white and salt
Banana leaf or foil for wrapping
Mix the chopped fish with the coconut milk, spring onion, garlic, turmeric, coriander, egg white and salt until well combined.
Shape the mixture into small logs on pieces of banana leaf or foil.
Wrap them tightly and secure both ends.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until fully cooked, and serve hot.

name.en: Baked Lumpia (Indonesian Spring Rolls)

en: Cooked, shredded chicken breast 60 g
Grated cabbage and grated carrot, 100 g total
Chopped spring onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Low-sodium sweet soy sauce half a tsp, salt and black pepper
Lumpia wrappers or thin pastry sheets, 4 pieces (60 g)
1 beaten egg for brushing and 1 tsp oil
Mix the shredded chicken with the cabbage, carrot, spring onion, garlic, soy sauce, salt and black pepper.
Place a spoonful of filling on each pastry sheet, roll tightly into a thin cylinder.
Arrange on a lined tray and brush with the beaten egg.
Bake at 220°C for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

name.en: Baked Sempol Ayam (Indonesian Chicken Sausage Skewers)

en: Lean minced chicken 140 g
2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped spring onion
Cornflour 2 tbsp and 1 egg
Salt and black pepper
An extra egg white for coating (optional)
Wooden skewers soaked in water
Knead the minced chicken with the garlic, spring onion, cornflour, egg, salt and black pepper thoroughly until it binds together.
Wet your hands and shape the mixture into long fingers around the wooden skewers.
Dip in the egg white if desired for a lighter crust.
Arrange on a lined tray and bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until fully cooked and golden.

name.en: Grilled banana with coconut

en: 1 ripe banana
1 tbsp desiccated coconut
1 tsp honey
A pinch of salt
A few drops of lime juice
Split the banana lengthwise without separating it
Grill on a dry pan 3 minutes per side
Toast the coconut a minute until fragrant
Scatter it over the banana with honey, salt and lime

name.en: Coconut rice pudding

en: 30 g rice flour
200 ml light coconut milk
1 tsp coconut sugar
Pandan leaf or vanilla
A pinch of salt
Whisk the rice flour into the cold coconut milk until smooth
Heat on low, stirring constantly
Cook 8 minutes until it thickens and turns glossy
Add the sugar and salt, pour into a cup and let it cool

name.en: Klepon (Sweet Rice Balls with Palm Sugar and Coconut)

en: Glutinous rice flour 50 g
Warm water about 40 ml with a drop of natural green colouring (optional)
Brown sugar or palm sugar, cut into small cubes, 30 g
Unsweetened grated coconut 30 g
A pinch of salt
Water for boiling
Knead the rice flour with the warm water and salt gradually until you get a soft dough with the texture of an earlobe.
Shape into small balls, press each ball to form a small hollow, place a cube of brown sugar inside and seal well to ensure the sugar doesn't leak.
Boil in boiling water 5-7 minutes until they float to the surface, which means they are cooked.
Remove and toss immediately in the grated coconut until fully coated, and serve immediately while warm.

name.en: Kolak Pisang (Banana and Sweet Potato in Coconut Milk)

en: 1 ripe banana, cut into large pieces (100 g)
Sweet potato, cubed, 100 g
Light coconut milk 150 ml
Brown sugar 25 g and a pinch of salt
A kaffir lime leaf or a small cinnamon stick (optional)
Water 100 ml
Boil the sweet potato in the water 8-10 minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the coconut milk, brown sugar, salt and kaffir lime leaf, cook over medium heat 5 minutes.
Add the banana and cook 5-7 more minutes until the sweet potato is fully cooked and the banana softens without dissolving.
Remove the kaffir lime leaf or cinnamon stick, and serve warm or cold.

name.en: Dadar Gulung (Rolled Pancake with Sweet Coconut Filling)

en: Whole-wheat flour 40 g
1 egg
Low-fat milk 70 ml
A drop of natural green colouring (optional)
Unsweetened grated coconut 30 g and brown sugar 25 g for the filling
A pinch of salt and 1 tsp oil for cooking
Beat the egg with the milk, flour and a pinch of salt until a smooth, lump-free batter forms, add a drop of green colouring if desired.
For the filling, mix the grated coconut with the brown sugar in a small pan over low heat 3-4 minutes until the sugar dissolves and the coconut absorbs it.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil and pour a thin layer of the pancake batter, cook 1 to 1.5 minutes until set without flipping.
Place a spoonful of the filling in the centre, fold the sides in then roll it up like a cylinder, repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm.

name.en: Baked Indonesian Bread Pudding with Coconut

en: Whole-wheat bread, 3 slices (90 g)
1 egg
Light coconut milk 150 ml
Brown sugar 2 tsp and a pinch of ground cinnamon
Unsweetened grated coconut 1 tbsp for garnish
Vanilla extract half a tsp
Cut the bread slices into cubes, arrange in a small oven-safe dish.
Beat the egg with the coconut milk, brown sugar, cinnamon and vanilla.
Pour it over the bread and let it sit 10 minutes to soak in.
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until set and golden on top, sprinkle with grated coconut and serve warm.

name.en: Bubur Sumsum (Rice Flour Pudding with Palm Sugar Syrup)

en: Rice flour 40 g
Light coconut milk 250 ml
A pinch of salt
Brown sugar 30 g for the syrup
Water 50 ml and a kaffir lime leaf for the syrup (optional)
Pandan or banana leaf for flavour (optional)
Dissolve the rice flour in a quarter cup of the cold coconut milk until smooth without lumps.
Heat the remaining coconut milk with the salt until near boiling, gradually stir in the flour mixture, stirring constantly.
Cook over low heat 8-10 minutes, stirring, until the texture thickens like a creamy pudding.
For the syrup, dissolve the brown sugar in the water with the kaffir lime leaf over low heat 5 minutes, pour the pudding into a serving bowl and drizzle the syrup over it, and serve warm.

name.en: Baked Kue Lapis (Indonesian Layered Coconut Cake)

en: Rice flour 50 g
Cornflour 20 g
Light coconut milk 200 ml
Brown sugar 40 g and a pinch of salt
A drop of natural red or pink colouring (optional)
1 tsp oil for the tin
Mix the rice flour and cornflour with the coconut milk, brown sugar and salt until completely smooth without lumps.
Divide the mixture into two portions, add a drop of colouring to one if desired.
Grease a small tin with oil, pour a thin layer of the plain batter, bake at 180°C for 5-6 minutes until it sets.
Pour a layer of the coloured batter on top and bake 5-6 more minutes, keep alternating the layers until the batter is used up, let the cake cool completely before slicing.

name.en: Baked Kue Cubit (Mini Fluffy Pancakes)

en: Whole-wheat flour 50 g
1 egg
Low-fat milk 60 ml
Brown sugar 2 tsp
Baking powder half a tsp and a pinch of salt
1 tsp oil for the tin
Beat the egg with the brown sugar until the mixture becomes slightly pale.
Add the milk and mix, then gradually add the flour, baking powder and salt until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into small greased muffin tins up to two-thirds full.
Bake at 180°C for 15-18 minutes until they puff up and spring back when pressed gently, let cool slightly before serving.

name.en: Wajik Ketan (Sticky Rice Cake with Palm Sugar and Coconut)

en: Cooked glutinous rice (ketan) 150 g
Light coconut milk 100 ml
Brown sugar or palm sugar 50 g
A pinch of salt
A kaffir lime leaf or pandan leaf (optional)
1 tsp oil for the tin
Heat the coconut milk with the brown sugar, salt and kaffir lime leaf in a pan over medium heat until the sugar fully dissolves.
Add the cooked glutinous rice and stir constantly over low heat 10-12 minutes until the rice absorbs the liquid and becomes glossy and sticky.
Pour it into a small greased tin and press with a spoon to compact it evenly.
Let it chill completely in the fridge for at least an hour before cutting into squares and serving.
